name: Can-Am Ryker
engine: 600 cc twin or 900 cc triple, Rotax, fuel injected, CVT, shaft drive, two front wheels
intro: Can-Am's lighter three-wheeler. A twist-and-go CVT, shaft drive and car-like front suspension.

L: The front end has ball joints and tie rods like a car. Check them for play and torn boots.

recallNote: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start. Recalls on these models change over time.
